back: A program that others can easily read, understand, correct and update.
A name that describes what a variable, constant, array or subroutine holds or does, e.g. TotalSales.
Text for human readers, ignored by the computer; starts with // in pseudocode.
Explain purpose and method (why/what), not the obvious; keep them up to date.
A fixed value declared once as a constant is changed in one place and its name explains it.
Repeated code written once: reused, tested separately, changed in one place.
Letters and digits only, start with a capital letter, PascalCase, no underscores, never a keyword.
Comments, constants, global declarations, subroutine definitions, main program.
Making code more maintainable must not change what it does: test with the same data before and after.
